mapper.select: SELECT ec.class_id, c.name AS class_name, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM student st WHERE st.class_id = ec.class_id AND st.deleted = 0) AS student_count FROM exam_class ec LEFT JOIN class_info c ON c.id = ec.class_id WHERE ec.exam_id = #{examId} AND ec.deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.sort ASC, c.create_time ASC
mapper.delete: UPDATE exam_class SET deleted = 1 WHERE exam_id = #{examId}
